name: hyperhdr
description: HyperHDR is an open source ambient lighting software with HDR tone mapping support. Captures video from a USB capture card and drives LED strips via USB or network controllers. This image is automatically built and published within 24 hours of each upstream HyperHDR release, including beta versions. Use the "latest" tag for the newest stable release, or "beta" to always run the latest beta. You can also pin to any specific version tag. The web interface will be available at: http://Unraid_IP:8090

ports.name: Flatbuffers Server Port
ports.description: Flatbuffers server port for high-speed LED data input

devices.name: Video Device
devices.description: USB capture card device path. Remove if not using a capture card.
